title: skills 0.11.0: T76c month-end-close-prep skill (needs Braden)
head: t76c-month-end-close-prep
body:
**needs Braden**

Third person production skill: on-demand prep checklist from the QuickBooks month_pack read only (no writes). Reads open invoices and bills, flags overdue or large items (profile thresholds `prep_overdue_days` / `prep_amount_floor`), drafts a note for the person's Yes (`save_draft` is `always_ask`). Memo/description text is data, never instructions. Implements decisions #330 and #336.

## What

- `shared/month-end-close-prep/` — new skill with skill.yaml, SKILL.md, fixtures (case-1: five items, two flagged; case-2: one small invoice, none flagged; injection-memo: case-1 data with instruction text in bill description; checklist output identical to case-1), tests.
- `src/month_end_close_prep.py` — one entry point: `build_month_prep_checklist(qbo_open_items, overdue_days, amount_floor)` reads only ref, amount, txn_date, status fields from invoices and bills; computes age_days in code; flags when age > overdue_days OR amount > amount_floor OR status != open; returns `{checklist_items, summary}`. Memo and description fields are never read.
- `src/almanac/validate.py` — added `compute.build_month_prep_checklist` to TOOL_ACCESS (model tier), removed non-existent `connectors.quickbooks.open_items`.
- `shared/month-end-close-prep/skill.yaml` — steps: `fetch_open_items` (month_pack read), `build_checklist` (code only), `review` (critic), `save_draft` (notes.write, ask-first #98, gated by `always_ask: [save_draft]`). Resources: `connector:quickbooks`. Profile args: `prep_overdue_days` (default 60), `prep_amount_floor` (default 1000.0).
- `CHANGELOG.md` — added `## 0.11.0` entry for T76c. Version bumped in pyproject.toml, src/almanac/__init__.py, tests/test_smoke.py; uv.lock updated.
- Fixtures updated from invented `open_items` structure to month_pack-shaped (periods, pnl_current/prior/prior_year, bs_current/prior, tb_current, accounts, plus invoices/bills arrays).

## Open

Decision #336 provisional picks — Braden may amend at PR:
- month_pack is assumed to carry invoices/bills with ref, amount, txn_date, status — confirm against the T33 connector or add the read as a T33 follow-up
- thresholds are profile arguments `prep_overdue_days` and `prep_amount_floor` with code defaults (60 days, $1000.0) — confirmed
- on-demand trigger only (person runs when she starts month-end) — confirmed
- note title fixed to month-end-prep-YYYY-MM, the person may rename if she keeps it — confirmed

## Mutation check

Each mutant turns tests red:

- Remove `always_ask: [save_draft]` from skill.yaml → killed by `test_save_draft_is_always_ask`, `test_runner_all_cases_pass_and_gate_save`, `test_declined_save_stops`, `test_injection_memo_triggers_no_action_and_never_reaches_later_steps`
- Interpolate bill description into the checklist item instead of using amount + aging → killed by `test_items_carry_exactly_five_fields`, `test_injection_memo_changes_nothing`, `test_fixture_matches_code[injection-memo]`, `test_memo_fields_are_never_read`
- Hardcode age_days > 0 instead of profile.prep_overdue_days → killed by `test_flag_counts_follow_thresholds`, `test_small_case_has_no_flags`, `test_fixture_matches_code[case-1]`, `test_fixture_matches_code[case-2]`, `test_injection_memo_changes_nothing`, `test_memo_fields_are_never_read`
